title: Great vacuum, poor battery life.
text:
Great vacuum, poor battery life.. I only have one complaint and that is battery life. Thought it would be great not fighting with a cord, but I can’t finish a room with the battery. That’s vacuuming the hard wood floors and the rug. The vacuum it’s self is great, cleans up all the dust from the hard wood floors, no more sweeping before I vacuum.
Just wish I could give it a higher rating, but can’t because of battery life. I hate to have to spend more money on another battery.
